theme: Light mode by default for admin dashboard to ensure data readability, dark mode option available. Client portal has a slightly more consumer-friendly vibrant look.

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro (Deep Obsidian + White + Volt Blue)
rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint grays slightly blue.
Ensure contrast ratios are 4.5:1 for normal text.
Limit use of primary color strictly to CTAs.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

headings.rules: Tracking-tight on sizes above 32px. Never center headings by default.

body.rules: High legibility, leading-relaxed for body copy, tight for data.

typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-5xl on desktop. Use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for overlines/labels.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4), gap-4 or gap-6. Direct children must be grid items.
grids.client_portal: Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3), gap-6 or gap-8.

layouts.spacing_strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8 in containers. For cards with borders, ensure padding prevents text collision.
layouts.navigation: Every page MUST have a visible nav bar. No transparent headers over hero images - use glassmorphism or solid background.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align data and forms.

component_name.cards: Cardless or subtle roundness (max 8px). Flat solid surfaces with 1px border. Hover: -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg.
component_name.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Sharp focus rings.
component_name.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. Left aligned labels.
component_name.charts: Shadcn charts/Recharts. Use semantic colors for data. Accessible tooltips.
component_name.tables: Dense rows for Admin, more spacious for Client portal. 1px borders.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only for sticky headers/floating navs. bg-white/70 or bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px delicate inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Do not use. Stick to flat and crisp (Grid Borders technical look).
visual_enhancers.status_pills: Use vibrant backgrounds with high contrast text for Active/Inactive/Pending statuses.

motion.transitions: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease (Never transition: all).
motion.interactions: Hover states must darken/lighten distinctly. Click/press states scale down slightly (scale-95).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items (Framer Motion).

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text (APCA). Use text shadows over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

media.images: Max height 80vh on mobile. Never use placeholder URLs.
media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Phosphor icons for dense dashboards.

3d_libraries_and_steps.decision: Not mandatory for data-heavy CRM, but React Recharts is MANDATORY for data visualization (data consumption gauges, revenue charts).
3d_libraries_and_steps.data_viz: Use Recharts for line, bar, and donut charts. Add custom tooltips.

marketing_client.description: Woman enjoying smartphone in sunny day

admin_dashboard.category: Admin Login Background or Network Status Header

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Outfit and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.html.
Install recharts for consumption and revenue KPIs.
Structure the app to support two layouts based on auth role: Admin (dense sidebar) vs Client (bento grid, top nav).
Configure Tailwind config colors to match the guidelines provided above.
Ensure all JS components use .js extensions as requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
